sources.title: A Practical Guide to Multilingual Large Language Model (RoBERTa ...
sources.snippet: This step-by-step tutorial provides a gentle introduction to customizing (fine-tuning) a pre-trained multilingual language model (RoBERTa) for text classification tasks. It demonstrates how to use the model's existing knowledge to classify text accurately, even with a small set of labeled examples.
